output_definition: Per scope: predicted log1p(|z|) of the two-session market response (z = abnormal return / trailing sigma), rank-calibrated to a 1-10 EventShock score with an empirical uncertainty interval; attributions are exact for the additive model.

checks.detail: Spearman of prediction vs realised |z|; pass if the 95% interval's lower bound > 0.0
checks.label: Rank skill on held-out episodes (val+test)

checks.detail: paired difference in log-severity MAE; pass if the 95% interval's upper bound < 0
checks.label: Error vs the constant baseline (val+test)

checks.detail: point difference in log-severity MAE <= 0.002 on each of val and test (R2-ridge)
checks.label: Not worse than the market-state linear model

checks.detail: Spearman of bucket order vs bucket median |z| >= 0.8 (needs >= 4 buckets of >= 10 episodes)
checks.label: Score buckets ordered by realised severity (val+test)

checks.detail: feature registry, group straddle, time order + embargo, rolling folds, fit invariance
checks.label: Leakage suite clean

checks.detail: skill that also predicts the window before the event is market state, not the event
checks.label: More skill on the real window than on the pre-event placebo (val+test)

checks.detail: the served documents are news with first-seen or publisher clocks, unlike the 2022 tweets
checks.label: Rank skill on 2026 news with publisher timestamps

acceptance.rule: Pre-registered in configs/impact_model.yaml before the first held-out run. PRODUCTION needs every check to pass: C1 rank skill above zero (val+test, 95% interval); C2 lower log-severity error than the constant (paired interval below zero); C3 not worse than the market-state-only linear model on val and on test; C4 predicted-score buckets ordered by realised severity; C5 the served realised-score interval covers close to its nominal share; C6 the leakage suite is clean; C7 more skill on the real window than on the pre-event placebo window; C8 skill on news (2026, publisher timestamps). A check that cannot be evaluated is not a pass.

scopes.algorithm: gradient boosting (interactions allowed) on log1p(|z|); params {'l2_regularization': 1.0, 'learning_rate': 0.05, 'max_depth': 3, 'max_iter': 100, 'min_samples_leaf': 100}

calibration.method: rank-calibrated: prediction -> percentile of the out-of-fold training predictions -> |z| at the same percentile of the realised severity distribution -> the target's own fixed cut points; interval = what comparable out-of-fold events realised

direction.note: sign of (P(pos) - P(neg)) vs sign of the realised abnormal return; 0.5 is a coin flip. Reported, not used by the score.

evaluations.title: 2026 news, publisher timestamps outside trading hours

ladder.verdict: diagnostic only (never served): uses issuer identity, a banned shortcut
not adopted: no significant out-of-fold gain over R0-constant
adopted: beats R0-constant out of fold, interval entirely below zero
not adopted: no significant out-of-fold gain over R2-additive
not adopted: no significant out-of-fold gain over R2-additive
adopted: beats R2-additive out of fold, interval entirely below zero
adopted: beats R3-additive out of fold, interval entirely below zero
diagnostic only (never served): needs raw text at serving time

leakage_findings: [INFO] feature_availability: all features are registered event-time features
[INFO] group_straddle: no episode spans two splits (10443 groups)
[INFO] time_order: splits are time ordered with the embargo respected: train 2015-01-02..2022-03-24, val 2022-04-01..2022-06-23, test 2022-07-01..2022-09-30, live 2026-02-17..2026-09-30
[INFO] rolling_folds: 20 rolling-origin folds: every fold trains >= 5 sessions before its test period; no episode straddles
[INFO] fit_invariance: refit with val/test/live labels scrambled gives bit-identical predictions
limitations: Held-out evidence is 347 episodes (val 166, test 181): intervals are wide.
Validation and test are 2022 tweets; training is mostly 2015-2019 tweets and headlines. News (2026) is the served domain and is scored separately.
The target is a coincident market-response proxy: coverage is partly a reaction to a move, so this is not a clean forecast.
34 current large caps: severity is calibrated for them and does not transfer to small or distressed issuers.
At least one acceptance check could not be evaluated for lack of data; that keeps the scope below PRODUCTION.
